hooks.command:
bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then VIOLATIONS=""; MANTINE=$(grep -n "@mantine/" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "@peppermint" | head -3); EFFECT=$(grep -n "useEffect" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "fetch|axios|\.get\(|\.post\(|api " | head -3); INLINE_AXIOS=$(grep -n "axios\.\(get\|post\|put\|patch\|delete\)\|new axios" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -3); if [ -n "$MANTINE" ]; then VIOLATIONS="$VIOLATIONS
[VIOLATION] Direct @mantine/ import — use @peppermint/ui instead:
$MANTINE"; fi; if [ -n "$EFFECT" ]; then VIOLATIONS="$VIOLATIONS
[VIOLATION] Possible useEffect data fetch — use useQuery instead:
$EFFECT"; fi; if [ -n "$INLINE_AXIOS" ]; then VIOLATIONS="$VIOLATIONS
[VIOLATION] Inline Axios call in event handler — use useMutation instead:
$INLINE_AXIOS"; fi; if [ -n "$VIOLATIONS" ]; then echo -e "[pre-edit] Anti-pattern detected in $FILE:$VIOLATIONS
Fix before proceeding."; fi; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "(layouts|modules|components)/.+\.tsx$"; then if grep -qiE " (status|action|badge|confirm|danger|delete|suspend|approve|reject|loading|error|empty|disabled|permission|unsaved) " "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo ""; echo "── Design primer (.claude/DESIGN.md) ──"; echo "Decision ladder: Safety > Truth > Clarity > Speed > Density > Consistency > Aesthetics"; echo "State != Action: badge/fact and button/lever must look and sit differently"; echo "Status = words + color + position — never color alone"; echo "Name the one question this component answers before laying out elements"; fi; fi; fi'

bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; echo "[new-file] File created. Quick checklist:"; echo "  - If this is a component: does a .types.ts file exist?"; echo "  - Is the barrel export (index.ts) updated?"; echo "  - If in packages/: is the group barrel updated?"; echo "  - If this is a new module or sub-module: run /update-ai-map"; if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "(layouts|modules|components)/.+\.tsx$"; then BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE" .tsx); echo ""; echo "── Output contract (.claude/DESIGN.md Part 6) ──"; echo "[ ] Empty state                 [ ] N/A"; echo "[ ] Loading / partial loading   [ ] N/A"; echo "[ ] Request-failed              [ ] N/A"; echo "[ ] Permission-denied           [ ] N/A"; echo "[ ] Read-only mode              [ ] N/A"; echo "[ ] Archived/deleted record     [ ] N/A"; echo "[ ] Conflicting edits           [ ] N/A"; if echo "$BASENAME" | grep -qiE "List|Table|Grid"; then echo "[ ] No-results state            (list/table detected — required)"; else echo "[ ] No-results state            [ ] N/A  (filterable lists only)"; fi; if echo "$BASENAME" | grep -qiE "Form|Modal|Dialog|Drawer"; then echo "[ ] Unsaved changes warning     (form/modal detected — required)"; else echo "[ ] Unsaved changes warning     [ ] N/A  (forms only)"; fi; if echo "$BASENAME" | grep -qiE "Dashboard"; then echo "[ ] Data freshness indicator    (dashboard detected — required)"; echo "[ ] Long-running job state      (dashboard detected — required)"; else echo "[ ] Long-running job state      [ ] N/A  (async actions only)"; fi; echo "[ ] One page-level anchor; regional anchors subordinate and non-competing"; echo "[ ] Actions labeled by risk tier; destructive actions spatially separated"; echo "[ ] Recovery path for every consequential action (undo/audit/retry/restore)"; fi'

bash -c 'CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -E "\.(tsx|ts)$"); if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then echo "[post-response] Modified TS/TSX files:"; echo "$CHANGED" | head -8; echo ""; VISUAL=$(echo "$CHANGED" | grep -E "(layouts|modules|components)/.*\.tsx$"); if [ -n "$VISUAL" ]; then echo "Before closing: /verify (includes design scan) · /design-check for full audit · /simplify if >10 lines changed · /update-ai-map if structure changed"; else echo "Before closing: /verify (typecheck+lint) · /simplify if >10 lines changed · /update-ai-map if structure changed"; fi; fi'
